display.purpose: Page titles. Landing hero scales to 3.8rem at >=900px; that is the ceiling.

label.purpose: Archivo UI labels, steps, and brass kickers (uppercase, 0.04-0.11em tracking).

shadows.name: panel-ambience
shadows.purpose: Default panel wash; barely perceptible by design.

shadows.name: menu-float
shadows.purpose: Nav disclosure menus and true overlays only.

shadows.name: legacy-shadow
shadows.purpose: Legacy --shadow token; must not spread to new surfaces.

motion.name: question-fade
motion.purpose: Quiz question remount fade; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass-filled action button for in-flow primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #cea857); color: var(--bg, #0a1322); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #cea857); border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-light, #e0c07f); border-color: var(--accent-light, #e0c07f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #cea857) 70%, white 30%); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Panel-toned button with hairline border for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--panel, #122139); color: var(--text, #eef2f7); border: 1px solid var(--border, #22344f); border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #cea857); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #cea857); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #cea857) 70%, white 30%); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Primary CTA Pill
components.description: Brass pill link-button for page-level calls to action.
components.css: .ds-cta-primary { display: inline-block; background: var(--accent, #cea857); color: var(--bg, #0a1322); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #cea857); border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 22px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-light, #e0c07f); border-color: var(--accent-light, #e0c07f); } .ds-cta-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #cea857) 70%, white 30%); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Option Card
components.description: The quiz answer affordance: badge + serif title + muted text; brass ring on hover, brass badge and accent tint when selected. Never auto-advances.
components.css: .ds-option-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: var(--panel, #122139); color: var(--text, #eef2f7); border: 1px solid var(--border, #22344f); border-radius: 5px; padding: 18px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-option-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #cea857); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #cea857); } .ds-option-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #cea857) 70%, white 30%); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-option-badge { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #22344f); background: var(--panel-2, #0e1a2e); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #8295ab); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-option-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-option-title { font-family: var(--font-serif, Newsreader), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-option-text { color: var(--muted, #8295ab); font-family: var(--font-serif, Newsreader), Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Tradition Chip
components.description: Content-bound tradition label; ink fill with navy text. Only appears attached to its named tradition.
components.css: .ds-chip-tradition { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--t-realist, #d98a5a); color: var(--bg, #0a1322); font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; }

components.name: Mode Pill
components.description: Outlined pill for modes and wayfinding steps; brass text on panel tone.
components.css: .ds-mode-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #22344f); background: var(--panel-2, #0e1a2e); border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent, #cea857); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header text link; hover/active draw a 1px brass-mixed underline via inset box-shadow. No boxes, no fills.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: var(--font-sans, Archivo), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted, #8295ab) 88%, var(--text, #eef2f7) 12%); text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 0; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 transparent; transition: color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--text, #eef2f7); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, #22344f) 54%, var(--accent, #cea857) 46%); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #cea857) 70%, white 30%); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: 6px hairline-bordered pill track with brass fill; states facts, never fake precision.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; height: 6px; background: var(--panel-2, #0e1a2e); border: 1px solid var(--border, #22344f); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent, #cea857); border-radius: 999px; transition: width 0.3s ease; }

components.name: Callout
components.description: Inline editorial aside on a lightened panel tone with a hairline frame.
components.html: Scores are interpretive summaries of a multidimensional profile, not population percentiles.
components.css: .ds-callout { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2, #0e1a2e) 76%, white 24%); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, #304563); border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #cea857) 30%, var(--border, #22344f) 70%); border-radius: 9px; padding: 18px 22px 18px 20px; } .ds-callout-text { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif, Newsreader), Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--text, #eef2f7); max-width: 66ch; }

narrative.overview:
A precision brass instrument read against a deep navy night. The interface is the instrument, not the spectacle: a calm, dark field of Meridian Navy on which a single calibrated accent — Sextant Brass — marks action, selection, and orientation. Everything else is drawn in hairlines and tonal panels, the way an astrolabe's scales are engraved rather than painted. The register is a serious policy-journal interactive: serif prose carries the reading voice, small sans labels do the instrument's engraving, and mono appears only for micro/technical readouts.

This system explicitly rejects the surfaces PRODUCT.md names as anti-references: it must never resemble a SaaS dashboard, an AI demo, a personality-test funnel, a therapy app, lecture notes, or a dissertation abstract. No gradients, no neon, no glassmorphism, no oversized shadows, no stacked identical cards, no decorative charts, no fake precision. Density is editorial, not dashboard: article measures capped near 66ch, hairline-divided lists preferred over card grids, generous vertical rhythm around each reading surface.

Motion is state, not choreography: 120–300ms eases on hover, border, and selection changes; a single 150ms fade between quiz questions; every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback. The theme is dark-only (color-scheme: dark); print gets a flat black-on-white override — that is a media adaptation, not a second theme.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only navy field with one brass accent; color is calibration, not decoration.
Serif-led editorial typography (Newsreader) with sans (Archivo) reserved for UI labels and mono (Space Mono) for micro readouts.
Depth drawn with 1px hairlines and tonal panel steps; shadows are vestigial (≤0.08 alpha).
Hairline-divided editorial lists over card grids; pills for CTAs and wayfinding chips.
Calibrated and quiet components: thin borders, exact states, brass only for action and selection.

rules.name: The Brass Discipline Rule
rules.body: Sextant Brass marks action, selection, and orientation only. If an element is not interactive, not selected, and not a wayfinding label, it does not get brass.

rules.name: The Tradition Ink Rule
rules.body: The four tradition colors are content-bound: they may only appear attached to their named tradition (chips, rules, callouts). They are never ambient decoration, chart garnish, or generic category colors.

rules.name: The Serif Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader speaks; Archivo labels; Space Mono measures. Never set running prose in Archivo, never set a heading in Space Mono, and never introduce a fourth family.

rules.name: The Quiet Kicker Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels exist as a deliberate brass-toned system (.eyebrow, .section-kicker) — use them where the codebase already does (section wayfinding), and never stack one above every heading by reflex.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from a 1px Hairline border plus a tonal panel step. A shadow may accompany that separation as ambience; it may never be the separation.

dos: Do keep Sextant Brass under discipline: action, selection, orientation — roughly ≤10% of any screen.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tonal steps; reuse the existing color-mix panel steps instead of minting new hexes.
Do cap prose at 56–66ch and keep the serif voice for everything a person reads.
Do ship every interactive state (hover, focus-visible with the 2px offset brass outline, selected, disabled) and a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation.
Do prefer hairline-divided lists for collections, and keep navigation reversible — no auto-advance on selection, ever.
Do use the tradition inks only where their tradition is actually named.
donts: Don't resemble a "SaaS dashboard, AI demo, personality-test funnel, therapy app, lecture notes, or dissertation abstract" (PRODUCT.md, verbatim).
Don't use "gradients, neon, glassmorphism, oversized shadows, stacked identical cards, decorative charts, fake precision, or self-discovery language" (PRODUCT.md, verbatim).
Don't add a light theme; the system is dark-only and the print stylesheet is the sole light rendering.
Don't cast structural shadows or grow the legacy --shadow token's use; ambience stays ≤0.08 alpha.
Don't use colored side-stripes thicker than 1px, gradient text, or identical card grids.
Don't introduce a fourth typeface, set prose in Archivo, or put confidence/percentile language in UI copy unless methodologically justified.
Don't let tradition colors drift into ambient decoration or generic category coding.
